snippet.title: Goat Simulator 3 – Out now on Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Goat Simulator 3 is out today on Nintendo Switch 2.
Dress up your goat in gears to gain magical, action-filled, and futuristic abilities. Use your powers to create as much chaos and destruction as possible in the different worlds of Goat Simulator 3.

Unleash your inner goat here: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/goat-simulator-3-switch-2/

Apart from the base game, the following content is also available on the NSW2 version of Goat Simulator 3: Digital Downgrade, Multiverse of Nonsense, Baadlands: Furry Road, Hocus Pocus Pack, Super Duper Pack, and Buck to the Future Pack.
